jei.yanscriptures.book.hamlet.detail.4: · Crit multiplier = 1 + crit damage attribute (at least the vanilla 150%).
jei.yanscriptures.book.the_count_of_mont: · The list only records creatures that have dealt damage to you; monsters you hit do not join it.
· Creatures you kill, or that die on their own, are removed from the list.
· The red outline uses team colouring and does not interfere with other mods' glowing effects.
· The attack speed only applies while the list is non-empty; clearing the list removes it at once.
jei.yanscriptures.book.critique_of_pure_: · Enchantments count by the number of distinct enchantments in a slot: an item with two enchantments counts 2, and two separate Sharpness books in two slots count 2.
· The range is the hotbar, inventory and armor slots; an enchantment book filling a slot does not count.
· Creative flight requires "more than 21 slots holding items", each of them enchanted; empty slots are fine.
· The damage reduction applies to all creatures as long as you have not hit them yourself; once you hit one, this clause stops working on it.
jei.yanscriptures.book.capital.detail.1: · Capital from a kill equals the creature's max health, at most 100 per kill (a 200-health mob still gives 100).
jei.yanscriptures.book.capital.detail.2: · +50 for trading with a villager; +15 for trading with a piglin using gold ingots (handing it the ingot by right-click, or dropping the ingot at its feet and letting it pick it up — both count).
jei.yanscriptures.book.capital.detail.3: · The attack bonus adds up in steps of 500, capping at +30% with 15000 capital.
jei.yanscriptures.book.capital.detail.4: · Capital lives on the player: death halves it, logging out and back in does not clear it; taking the book off only suspends the bonus, it does not reset capital.
jei.yanscriptures.book.nicomachean_ethic: · The counter only grows while "a hostile creature is watching you" or "you are attacking a hostile creature"; passive creatures do not count.
· One layer every 5 seconds, in order: movement speed → attack → crit rate and crit damage → damage dealt → bonus damage; later layers include the earlier ones.
· Taking any damage resets the timer to zero and removes every layer at once — you start over.
· 10 seconds without fighting also counts as leaving combat and resets it.
jei.yanscriptures.book.one_thousand_and_: · Only a full night's sleep counts: being interrupted or woken up gives no growth.
· Settled once per in-game day; sleeping the same night twice does not stack.
· Attribute growth is given in percentages (armor and toughness are flat, given in points) and is shown in the Book slot panel.
· [Story] is once per day and does not consume a growth tick when it triggers.
· [Son], [Father] and [Spirit] are triggered by "taking damage", "dealing damage" and "gaining experience"; each refreshes its own 10 second timer independently.
· The [Father] ring settles once per second; its damage is based on your attack damage, benefits from all damage bonuses, but does not consume the enemy's invulnerability frames.
· The [Spirit] attribute bonus only applies while its mark exists; the doubled drops only apply to creatures you kill.
· While wearing The Covenant Codex every value is raised to the bracketed tier; each extra commandment blessing adds +5% to the base value.
· [Son]: damage above 700% of your max health is ignored entirely, otherwise you take at most 49%.
